newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahrend sees profit increase in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Ahrend sees profit increase in 1997.

text.p: Office equipment group Koninklijke Ahrend NV said on Tuesday it expected a further improvement in profits in 1997.

The company earlier posted 1996 net profit of 41.8 million guilders ($21.8 million), up from 33.5 million in the previous year. In January, Ahrend said it expected a preliminary 1996 net of 41.8 million.

"For 1997, Ahrend expects, given the order information in both its sectors, and good capacity utilisation at its plants...a further increase of profits," the company said in a statement. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040 ($ = 1.917 Dutch Guilders)
